goal: Update the Guix build environment (time-machine commit) to pull in newer binutils, cmake, kernel headers, and python-lief, keeping the reproducible-build toolchain current.
Also fixes a RISC-V build failure and works around a psutil test failure in python-lief.
reviewability: Draft and still being reworked: reviewers found the update fails to build on aarch64 and even hit a fresh binutils hash mismatch on 2026-09-15.
A maintainer suggests overlapping work in #36233 might supersede parts of this and should land first.
agreement: Several members (0xB10C, willcl-ark, fanquake) reproduced matching x86_64 build hashes, a positive signal for the change.
Unresolved: aarch64 cross-gcc build fails for multiple testers (janb84, hebasto, willcl-ark), and a workaround is still being debated, not yet fixed by the author.

categories.name: build
why: P2 because it keeps the release build toolchain current and includes a stated bug fix (unblocking RISC-V builds, referencing issue #36232).
Release integrity is the top concern for guix, and until the aarch64 build failures are resolved this cannot safely ship, but the direction (routine dependency bump) is uncontroversial.

result.summary: This PR updates the Guix time-machine commit used for reproducible builds, bumping binutils, cmake, linux-libre-headers, and python-lief, along with related manifest and build-script adjustments (CMAKE_LINK_WARNING_AS_ERROR, disabling fixincludes on the sans-libc cross-gcc, reverting a temporary osslsigncode package). It has gone through many iterations (11 commits, 10 force-pushes) as new upstream Guix revisions were tracked over roughly seven weeks.
result.problem: The Guix build environment pins specific upstream package versions; as the underlying `guix` channel and toolchains evolve, Bitcoin Core's reproducible build recipe needs periodic updates to stay buildable, secure, and compatible with newer compilers/tools, and to pick up fixes like RISC-V build support.

open_concerns: aarch64 cross-gcc build fails with a 'BUILD_SYSTEM_HEADER_DIR does not exist' fixincludes error (janb84, hebasto, willcl-ark); a workaround was proposed by janb84 but not adopted by the author, willcl-ark suggested disabling fixincludes upstream instead.
willcl-ark hit a binutils-2.47 tarball hash mismatch on 2026-09-15, unclear if resolved by the latest push.
maflcko suggests overlapping PR #36233 (and previously #33593) may supersede parts of this and should possibly be merged first, including a version-comment convention the author hasn't yet added.
python-elfesteem build failure due to missing setuptools dependency in codesign manifest (willcl-ark, 2026-08-12), status unclear.
resolved_concerns: Author agreed to keep ci/lint/requirements.txt's lief version matching Guix and opened #35869 to fix an unused reference (maflcko/fanquake).

categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Directly modifies contrib/guix manifests, build scripts, and time-machine pin; labeled Build system.
categories.rationale: Commit message states the time-machine bump 'is necessary to unblock building on RISC-V systems. Fixes #36232', a concrete supported-platform breakage fix. It also keeps the reproducible-build toolchain (binutils, cmake, kernel headers, lief) current, which matters for release integrity, but the PR itself is currently failing to build on aarch64 for multiple testers, which is a real regression risk if merged as-is.

uncertainties: Whether the 2026-09-16 force-push resolved the aarch64 fixincludes failure or the binutils hash mismatch is not stated in the discussion.
Exact relationship/overlap between this PR and #36233 is unclear beyond maflcko's comment; unclear if they will be merged separately or one will subsume the other.
No explicit maintainer decision on the aarch64 fixincludes workaround (janb84's patch vs. willcl-ark's upstream suggestion).
result.card: This PR bumps the Guix time-machine commit and associated toolchain versions (binutils 2.47, cmake 4.3.3, newer kernel headers, python-lief 1.0.0) used for Bitcoin Core's reproducible Guix builds, and includes a fix needed to unblock RISC-V builds (closes #36232). Multiple members confirmed matching reproducible-build hashes on x86_64, but janb84, hebasto, and willcl-ark all report the update currently fails to build on aarch64 due to a fixincludes/sysroot issue in the cross-gcc bootstrap, and willcl-ark hit a fresh binutils hash mismatch as of 2026-09-15. The PR is draft, has been force-pushed ten times over seven weeks as the author chases a moving upstream Guix target, and a maintainer (maflcko) suggests it may overlap with #36233 which could land first. Build-system priority is moderate to high since routine Guix updates matter for release integrity and this one carries a stated platform-fix payoff, but the outstanding aarch64 failure means the current code is not yet safe to merge.
